cnd13:2.1: yasmiṃ kāmā na vasantīti: yasmiṃ kāmā na vasanti, na saṃvasanti na āvasanti na parivasantīti
cnd13:3.1: taṇhā yassa na vijjatīti: taṇhā yassa natthi, na santi na saṃvijjati nūpalabbhati ñāṇagginā daḍḍhāti
cnd13:4.1: kathaṅkathā ca yo tiṇṇoti: kathaṅkathā ca yo tiṇṇo uttiṇṇo nittiṇṇo atikkanto samatikkanto vītivattoti
cnd13:5.1: vimokkho tassa kīdisoti: vimokkho tassa kīdiso, kiṃsaṇṭhito kiṃpakāro, kiṃpaṭibhāgo, icchitabboti vimokkhaṃ pucchatīti
cnd13:8.7: yasmiṃ kāmā na vasantīti: yasmiṃ kāmā na vasanti, na saṃvasanti, na āvasanti, na parivasanti,
cnd13:10.2: ‘taṇhā’ti: rūpataṇhā saddataṇhā gandhataṇhā rasataṇhā phoṭṭhabbataṇhā dhammataṇhā.
cnd13:10.4: taṇhā yassa navijjatīti taṇhā yassa natthi, na santi na saṃvijjati nūpalabbhati, pahīnā samucchinnā vūpasantā paṭippassaddhā abhabbuppattikā ñāṇagginā daḍḍhāti
cnd13:11.4: kathaṅkathā ca yo tiṇṇoti kathaṅkathā ca yo tiṇṇo, uttiṇṇo, nittiṇṇo atikkanto samatikkanto vītivattoti
cnd13:12.1: vimokkho tassa nāparoti: natthi tassa aparo vimokkho,
cnd13:15.1: nirāsaso so uda āsasānoti nittaṇho so udāhu sataṇho, rūpe āsiṃsati sadde-
cnd13:15.31: diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbe dhamme āsiṃsati icchati sādiyati pattheti piheti abhijappatīti
cnd13:16.2: ‘paññāṇavā so’ti: paṇḍito paññavā buddhimā ñāṇī vibhāvī medhāvī.
cnd13:16.3: uda paññakappīti: udāhu aṭṭhasamāpattiñāṇena vā pañcābhiññāñāṇena vā micchāñāṇena vā taṇhākappaṃ vā diṭṭhikappaṃ vā kappeti, janeti saṃjaneti nibbatteti abhinibbattetīti
cnd13:17.4: athavā aḍḍho mahaddhano dhanavā tipi sakko,
cnd13:17.6: saddhādhanaṃ sīladhanaṃ hiridhanaṃ ottappadhanaṃ sutadhanaṃ cāgadhanaṃ paññādhanaṃ satipaṭṭhānadhanaṃ sammappadhānadhanaṃ iddhipādadhanaṃ indriyadhanaṃ baladhanaṃ bojjhaṅgadhanaṃ maggadhanaṃ phaladhanaṃ nibbānadhananti.
cnd13:17.7: tehi anekavidhehi dhanaratanehi aḍḍho mahaddhano dhanavātipi sakko.
cnd13:17.8: athavā pahu visavī alamatto sūro vīro vikkanto abhīru acchambhī anutrāsī apalāyī pahīnabhayabheravo vigatalomahaṃsotipi sakko.
cnd13:17.9: muniṃ ahaṃ sakka yathā vijaññanti: sakka, yathā ahaṃ muniṃ jāneyyaṃ ājāneyyaṃ vijāneyyaṃ paṭivijāneyyaṃ paṭivijjheyyanti
cnd13:18.2: ‘taṃ’ti: yaṃ pucchāmi, yaṃ yācāmi, yaṃ ajjhesāmi, yaṃ pasādemi.
cnd13:18.3: viyācikkhāti: ācikkhāhi desehi paññapehi paṭṭhapehi vivarāhi vibhajāhi uttānīkarohi pakāsehi.
cnd13:21.1: nirāsaso so na āsasānoti: nittaṇho so
cnd13:21.2: na so sataṇho so rūpe nāsiṃsati
cnd13:21.5: diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbe dhamme nāsiṃsati na icchati na sādiyati na pattheti na piheti nābhijappatīti
cnd13:22.2: ‘paññāṇavā’ti paṇḍito paññavā buddhimā ñāṇī vibhāvī medhāvī.
cnd13:22.3: na ca paññakappīti aṭṭhasamāpattiñāṇena vā pañcābhiññā ñāṇena vā micchāñāṇena vā taṇhā kappaṃ vā na kappeti, diṭṭhikappaṃ vā na kappeti, na janeti, na saṃjaneti, na nibbatteti, nābhinibbattetīti
cnd13:23.3: evampi todeyya muniṃ vijānāti todeyya evaṃ muniṃ jāna, paṭijāna paṭivijāna paṭivijjhāti
cnd13:24.2: ‘akiñcana’nti: rāgakiñcanaṃ dosakiñcanaṃ mohakiñcanaṃ mānakiñcanaṃ diṭṭhikiñcanaṃ kilesakiñcanaṃ duccaritakiñcanaṃ,
cnd13:24.3: yassetāni kiñcanāni pahīnāni samucchinnāni vūpasantāni paṭipassaddhāni, abhabbuppattikāni ñāṇagginā daḍḍhāni so vuccati akiñcano.
cnd13:25.1: akiñcanaṃ kāmabhave asattanti: akiñcanaṃ puggalaṃ kāme ca bhave ca asattaṃ alaggaṃ alaggitaṃ apalibuddhaṃ nikkhantaṃ nissaṭaṃ vippamuttaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharantanti
cnd13:27.2: satthā me bhante bhagavā sāvako hamasmīti.
